newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Becalmed Belgian bonds await New Year.
newsitem.headline: Becalmed Belgian bonds await New Year.

text.p: Belgian linear bonds were becalmed on Friday with no notable business reported and little expected until the New Year, traders said.
"There is absolutely nothing going on," one trader said. "There are some prices being quoted but there is no point in taking a position if you can't close it out again."

Traders said they expected the situation to remain the same for the rest of the day and at least on Monday and Tuesday next week, with little on the horizon to lift the market from its year-end lethargy until the first full week of trading starting on January 6.
The yield of the benchmark 2006 OLO was 5.89 percent against Tuesday's closing 5.90, and the spread over German Bunds was an unchanged 10 basis points.
The March futures contract was 10 basis points up at 120.10 with a scant 48 trades reported.
